d: Hitachi Energy is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales & Marketing Manager to join its Grid Integration Business Unit based in Bahrain. The candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth and developing innovative marketing strategies to expand market share and enhance brand visibility across various Grid Integration portfolio product lines and services.
q: Minimum 10 - 12 years of experience in the Power transmission, distribution and industry segments.
Knowledge on Substations, FACTS solutions, Prefabricated / Containerized Substations, Power Quality Solutions & BESS.
Strong understanding of renewable energy integration, data center electrification and grid modernization solutions.
Proven experience in developing and executing successful sales and market development strategies.
Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle, including opportunity management, bid management, contract negotiations, and customer relationship management.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in spoken and written English.
Experience with CRM and reporting tools such as Salesforce and Power BI will be an advantage.

d: We are looking for a Sales Executive with experience in the animal feed Industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales, expanding the customer base, and building strong relationships with livestock and poultry farmers, feed distributors, and industry stakeholders. The role requires fluency in Arabic and English to effectively communicate with diverse clients.
q: Identify and approach potential customers, including poultry farms, livestock farms, distributors, and dealers.
Promote and sell poultry feed, livestock feed, and other animal nutrition products.
Conduct regular customer visits to generate new business and maintain existing accounts.
Develop strong relationships with farmers, farm owners, purchasing managers, and key decision-makers.
Achieve monthly and annual sales targets as assigned by the Sales Manager.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable feed products.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and pricing.
Prepare quotations, follow up on customer orders, and coordinate deliveries.
Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely collection.
Maintain accurate records of customer visits, sales activities, orders, and market feedback.
Coordinate with the production and logistics teams to ensure timely product availability and delivery.
Prepare regular sales reports and provide updates to the Sales Manager.
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Agriculture, Animal Science, or a related field.
Additional qualifications in animal nutrition will be an advantage.
2–5 years of sales experience, preferably in animal feed, poultry feed, livestock feed, or animal nutrition.
Experience in B2B sales and customer relationship management.
Existing contacts with poultry farms, livestock farms, and feed distributors in Saudi Arabia will be an advantage.
